story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound 834 date sources for transaction effective date logic
gaps: TC_002 is the most closely related case, but the scenario also requires "EDI is able to identify the following dates in the EDI 834 file (existing functionality): Effective Date, Assessment Date, Maintenance Date." in acceptanceCriteriaRef and there is no test case covering Effective Date identification/population. Add a dedicated test case for it.

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for new enrollment before eligibility begins
scenarios.error: response is a single JSON test case object; return the complete JSON array of ALL test cases for the scenario, with the repaired cases fixed and every other case unchanged

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date for current eligibility when Assessment Date changes
gaps: Semantic duplicate: TC_002 and TC_001 validate the same business intent — changed Assessment Date uses 2025-06-29 as the transaction effective date for current eligibility and confirms unchanged relevant fields are maintained. TC_001 already covers the flow in Step Description "Using the Facets member eligibility result and the processed 834 content, verify that the transaction effective date applied to the current eligibility update corresponds to the changed Assessment Date 2025-06-29 rather than the unchanged Eligibility Date 2025-01-31." with Expected Result "The processed current eligibility update reflects transaction effective date 2025-06-29, proving the changed Assessment Date from Loop 2300 HD03 was used." and TC_002 repeats it in Step Description "Verify from the processed eligibility update and supporting stored data that the transaction effective date used for the current eligibility change is the changed Assessment Date 2025-06-29." with Expected Result "The current eligibility update uses 2025-06-29 as the transaction effective date while all six relevant field values remain unchanged."

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for future eligibility when changed field is not Assessment Date
Use Maintenance Date for current eligibility when changed field is not Assessment Date
scenarios.error: response is a single JSON test case object; return the complete JSON array of ALL test cases for the scenario, with the repaired cases fixed and every other case unchanged

scenarios.title: Do not use Maintenance Date outside the explicitly allowed rule paths
Regression coverage for capitation and finance outcomes after transaction effective date selection
gaps: Coverage gap attached to TC_002: scenario description requires "2) Corrected transaction effective date logic does not change capitation calculations." and the referenced acceptance criteria text includes "Confirm that Maintenance Date is only used when specified in acceptance criteria." Add a dedicated test case for the scenario-specific condition "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has already begun and any relevant fields have changed but Assessment Date has NOT changed, the Maintenance Date (DTP*303) populates as the transaction effective date."
